title: Show environment-specific chrome
packedServerEquality: Exact current built server DLL equals the frozen ordinary nupkg server DLL after the literal Inspector rebuild.
script:
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'V:\_worktrees\Playbook\agent-pin-795-04-023-present-environment-appropriate-application-chrome'
& {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
  $env:DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH = '0'
  $dotnet = 'C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe'
  $node = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./artifacts/pin795 -Force | Out-Null
  & $dotnet build ./src/PinguApps.Playbook -c Release -p:Version=0.0.0-pin795-r2
  & $node 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js' install --prefix ./artifacts/inspector --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.11.0
  $inspector = (Resolve-Path ./artifacts/inspector/node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/inspector/clients/launcher/build/index.js).Path
  $server = (Resolve-Path ./src/PinguApps.Playbook/bin/Release/net10.0/PinguApps.Playbook.dll).Path
  $call = { param($tool, $argument)
    & $node $inspector --cli --format json --quiet --method tools/call --tool-name $tool --tool-arg 'targetVersion="11.0"' --tool-arg $argument -- $dotnet $server mcp | ConvertFrom-Json
  }
  $entry = (& $call list_recipes 'query=copperline-chrome').result.structuredContent.recipes
  if ($entry.id -ne 'blazor.show-environment-specific-content') { throw 'Missing discovery' }
  $entry | Format-List id, title, goal
  $recipe = (& $call get_recipe 'id=blazor.show-environment-specific-content').result.structuredContent.recipe
  if ($recipe.edition -ne '11.0' -or -not $recipe.markdown -or $recipe.markdown.Contains('{{snippet:')) { throw 'Incomplete recipe' }
  $recipe | Format-List id, edition, stability
  $recipe.markdown
  $recipe.applicability.routes | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30
  $recipe.sources | Format-Table
  $recipe.evidence | Format-List
  $recipe | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | Set-Content ./artifacts/pin795/inspected-recipe.json
}
scope: Exact documented block executed from unrelated C:\Windows, including setup/build and actual stdio list_recipes/get_recipe. Printed full Markdown, applicability, edition, sources and evidence. Inspector 2.11.0, Node 24.21.0, SDK 10.0.402; no Git root discovery or assumed starting checkout.
goal: Mark test environments and show the controls intended for each renderer.
